title: Committed golden (state_hash/tick_nonce pin) is asserted by no engine-free gate, though the comparison mechanism needs no engine
evidence: scripts/local-ci.sh:76: `  "ENGINE:Golden compare (PPProbe vs docs/goldens/)|scripts/compare-golden.sh"` — the only golden consumer is engine-gated. scripts/compare-golden.sh:31-34 (the engine-free fallback): `  A="$GOLDEN"` / `  B="$TMP/standalone.json"` / `  WHAT="committed golden vs standalone spine-check"` / `fi`. tests/spine_check.cpp:161-163 prints the golden numbers without asserting them: `std::printf("{\"seed\":42,\"ticks\":100,\"tick_nonce\":%u,\"state_hash\":\"%016llx\"..."` — `grep -rn goldens tests/spine_check.cpp Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/` returns nothing. Mechanical run: `spine-check --json` output is byte-identical to docs/goldens/probe-seed42-ticks100.json, so the comparison would pass today if wired.
detail: A serialization-layout regression (field reorder, magic change) passes gates 1-3 because replay-equality checks are self-consistent; only the golden pins those bytes, and nothing asserts it until the engine installs.
recommended_fix: Move the committed-golden-vs-standalone compare out of the ENGINE: gates into the fast loop, or add inline CHECKs in spine_check.cpp asserting tick_nonce=2381141952 and state_hash=e8046b49de0f2447.

title: Engine-vs-standalone golden comparison is unreachable: no script ever writes docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json
evidence: scripts/compare-golden.sh:26-28: `if [ -f docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json ]; then` / `  A="docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json"` / `  B="$TMP/standalone.json"` — repo-wide grep for `engine-probe` matches ONLY these two read sites; nothing writes it. scripts/local-ci.sh:75 (gate 7): `  "ENGINE:PPProbe commandlet (headless spine probe)|scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe"` — no --json-out. The only --json-out caller is local-ci.sh:130 (--bless), which writes the golden path itself.
detail: Even with the engine installed, gate 8 always takes the golden-vs-standalone branch; the engine PPProbe's hash/tick_nonce numbers are never automatically compared to the standalone runner — the cross-runner contract the PR claims.
recommended_fix: Have gate 7 pass `--json-out docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json` so gate 8's engine-vs-standalone branch actually runs; alternatively drop the branch and compare the golden against both outputs explicitly.

title: Engine-free format gate never runs (mislabeled ENGINE:) and FAILS on 8 Source/ files when clang-format is present
evidence: scripts/local-ci.sh:70: `  "ENGINE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)|scripts/format-check.sh"` — gated on engine presence, though scripts/format-check.sh:15-16 falls back to `  "$(command -v clang-format 2>/dev/null || true)"; do`. AGENTS.md claims the pre-engine loop "always works": "`scripts/local-ci.sh --fast` — format, spine, static gates." Mechanical run at this sha (Homebrew clang-format 22.1.8, accepted by format-check.sh's own `grep -qE "version (1[4-9]|[2-9][0-9])"` check): `NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Hash.h` … 8 files total, exit 1 (violations e.g. PP_Hash.h:20 `inline uint64_t Fnv1a64(const uint8_t* Data, size_t Size)` pointer alignment). docs/timings.md:1,4 recorded gate 1 as SKIP.
detail: The shipped .clang-format was never validated: without the engine the gate skips despite a system clang-format being available, and when it does run it fails on 8 of the diff's files. Recorded gate-1 SKIP masked this.
recommended_fix: Remove the ENGINE: label from gate 1 (format needs only clang-format) and run clang-format over the 8 flagged files per the shipped config (pointer alignment drives most violations).

title: PP::Step guard branches (backward-tick ignore, bTerminal freeze) have zero tests in either runner
detail: These guards are state-affecting sim behavior (ODN-1); a regression that mutates state on backward ticks or after terminal would pass all 25 checks in both runners. Classic missing boundary tests for new state transitions.
recommended_fix: Add cases to both spine_check.cpp and PP_DeterminismTests.cpp: step backward (Tick < State.Tick) and with bTerminal=true, asserting the state hash is unchanged.

title: SerializeState capacity-guard branch (insufficient buffer returns 0) is untested
evidence: Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Sim.h:41: `	if (OutCapacity < Needed) { return 0; }` — no test calls SerializeState with a short buffer; PP_DeterminismTests.cpp:57 only uses `uint8_t Buffer[64];` with full capacity, and StateHash (PP_Sim.h:67-68) ignores the 0 return.
detail: The guard itself has no direct test. Mitigation exists: if StateHash ever hashed 0 bytes, every hash becomes the offset basis and the non-vacuity check fails — so the catastrophic case is transitively caught.
recommended_fix: Add one check per runner: `SerializeState(S, buf, Needed-1) == 0` (capacity guard) alongside the existing size assertion.

title: ODN-2 fixed-20Hz ini pin has no engine-free assertion
evidence: Config/DefaultEngine.ini:9-10: `bUseFixedFrameRate=True` / `FixedFrameRate=20.000000` — scripts/static-check.py checks uproject JSON, Build.cs presence, targets, bash -n, and CRLF only; nothing greps the ini. docs/research-report.md marks ODN-2 "✅ pinned (engine-gated verification pending install)".
detail: A config edit dropping the 20 Hz pin (ODN-2, named project convention) passes all runnable gates. A static grep would make this regression-visible engine-free.
recommended_fix: Extend scripts/static-check.py to assert DefaultEngine.ini contains bUseFixedFrameRate=True and FixedFrameRate=20 — cheap engine-free ODN-2 cover.

title: spine-check hardcodes "34 checks" but executes 25 CHECK invocations; README and PR body repeat the wrong count
evidence: tests/spine_check.cpp:180: `		std::printf("spine-check: ALL GREEN (34 checks)\n");` — the file has 15 CHECK call sites; two are loops (seed-0 ×8 at line 45, seed-42 ×4 at line 59), the other 13 run once: 8+4+13 = 25 executed checks, not 34. README.md repeats it: "reproduces the Odin pinned vectors byte-exact (34 checks green, no engine needed)".
detail: The reported check count is a hardcoded string, not derived from execution — it already disagrees with reality and will silently drift as checks are added, undermining the gate's audit trail.
recommended_fix: Increment a Checks counter inside the CHECK macro and print the real count; correct the 34 claim in README.md and the PR description.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: RNG pinned vectors dual-runner and Odin-exact (verified against core/rng_test.odin:15,27), replay equality, divergence, non-vacuity, serialization determinism — standalone output byte-identical to the golden. P1 ~85%: golden pin unasserted engine-free; engine-vs-standalone compare unreachable. Overall ~85%: Step guards, capacity guard, ini pin, format gate integrity untested. P0 100%, P1 80-89%, overall ≥80% → CONCERNS.
recommended_fix: Wire gate 7's --json-out to .engine-probe.json, un-gate the standalone golden compare, un-label and fix the format gate, add Step-guard boundary tests — lifts P1 ≥90% → PASS.
